title: The largest enhanced-geothermal PPA announced to date will feed AI - TCR 09/03/26
description:
Google signed the largest enhanced-geothermal power purchase agreement announced to date, a 396-megawatt deal with Fervo Energy expandable to nearly 1 gigawatt by 2030, Fei-Fei Li's World Labs released Atlas, an omni world model generating minute-long 1440p video from a single image, and a semaglutide-class drug extended older mice's lifespans by about 12 percent with biomarker changes suggesting a pathway distinct from calorie restriction.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-3-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:42 Google's record geothermal deal
3:37 World Labs ships Atlas world model
6:10 Google's Fairwind gate for cyber defense
8:41 Semaglutide extends lifespan in old mice
11:27 Justice Department backs OpenAI on fair use
14:46 Close

This episode covers Google's record Fervo geothermal deal and Cape Station's multi-gigawatt potential, World Labs' Atlas world model and its real-to-sim robotics workflow, Google's Fairwind Program gating Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber to a trusted few, the UC Berkeley semaglutide longevity study in Nature, the Justice Department's fair-use filing for OpenAI in the New York Times suit, and IBM's Nighthawk r2 quantum processor.

Google signed a 396-MW power purchase agreement with Fervo Energy for output from Cape Station in Utah, the largest enhanced-geothermal PPA announced to date, with an option toward a gigawatt of firm clean electricity by 2030. Analysts frame firm baseload as the scarce commodity of the compute buildout, and a hyperscaler is now underwriting first-of-a-kind wells directly. Fei-Fei Li's World Labs released Atlas, an omni model that reasons about space rather than only language, generating camera-controlled 1440p video and, according to World Labs, reconstructing 3D scenes from a few photos, with robotics as the clearest near-term application. A UC Berkeley team reported in Nature that late-life semaglutide extended older mice's lives by roughly 12 percent, matching calorie restriction on survival and producing what researchers reported as better results on cognitive tests alongside biomarker changes suggesting a distinct biochemical route. The Justice Department backed OpenAI's fair-use position in the Times copyright fight, arguing a Times win would threaten American AI leadership. Google also placed its strongest defensive cyber capability behind the Fairwind gate, and IBM's Nighthawk r2 crossed 100,000 quantum circuits per second.
